message: Blue Team reports maintenance delay on Vehicle 12. Estimated return to service is 45 minutes.
Replacement vehicle available if Vehicle 12 is not ready by 1445Z.
Decision: Shift convoy departure from 1430Z to 1515Z. Notify all section leads and update movement board.
All section leads acknowledged updated convoy departure time.
Weather cell approaching training route. Monitor visibility and reassess movement conditions at 1500Z.
No external threat indicators affecting convoy route at this time.
Vehicle 12 repair complete. Asset available for tasking.
Decision: Maintain revised 1515Z departure to preserve coordination timeline.
